issues: No attempt to get around the measurement: the one-line change only clamps the starting radii given to SLSQP. It caps them at 0.9*r0 and at each centre's distance to the nearest wall. There is no file access, no pasted coordinates and no use of labels.

The final result can't be made invalid by this change. It only touches the starting point, and the later clip and repair steps still produce the output. Small note: if _relocate ever puts a centre outside [0,1], the clamp would give a negative starting radius. That only affects the starting point, so it is not a reason to veto.
Recomputed z: the improvement is 2.9370 - 2.9346 = 0.0024. The standard error is 0.0034*sqrt(1/1 + 1/2) ≈ 0.00416, so z ≈ 0.58. That matches the harness's 0.572; the gap comes from rounding -2.937.

The candidate has only one run. Its mean of 2.937 equals the best published value, but the gain over the incumbent is within noise. Rejecting it for now matches the numbers; a replicate run is needed before accepting it.
